hypothesis: A compiled Beast capability improves matched task correctness or efficiency without increasing unsupported claims.

task_sequestration.burned_pool_rule: Any task, candidate domain, or source pool discussed with the compiler builders/reviewers before selection is pilot-only and cannot support a held-out claim.
task_sequestration.coordination_is_disclosure: Before sealing, candidate URLs, domains, task descriptions, pool contents, oracle facts, and acceptance details must not enter fleet mesh, committed design files, or shared agent workspaces; disclosure burns the candidate permanently for held-out use.
task_sequestration.shared_identity_residual_risk: Attestation is not hard access isolation when agents share one OS and GitHub identity; report this limitation with results.

conditions.description: Transcript-only control: the agent receives the source task, transcript, and normal tools, but no video frames or compiled Beast Pack.
Watching control: the same envelope receives the transcript and initial adaptive sparse frames, but no uncertainty-driven reinspection or compiled Beast Pack.
Same agent envelope receives the validated Beast Pack and its recovery/resource controls.

frozen_envelope: model, provider, version, and reasoning effort

hard_gates.acceptance: The run recovers at least one predeclared visual-only fact or action absent from the transcript.
An intentionally ambiguous video segment triggers retained uncertainty-driven reinspection.
The target artifact opens without repair or version conversion.
Required behavior executes in the target application.
The evidence and replay bundle is complete.
No claim exceeds the retained evidence level.
No unauthorized cloud, paid, publication, or destructive action occurs.

promotion_rule: A non-pilot Beast condition passes every hard gate, visual-only precision and reinspection recall are 1.0, unsupported claims and OOMs are zero, every predeclared acceptance assertion passes, at least one predeclared correctness or efficiency metric improves over the transcript-only baseline, no acceptance regression occurs, all three condition envelopes and repetitions are matched, and results include every run rather than the best run. The adaptive-frames condition isolates gains from initial visual sampling from gains that require reinspection.

claim_ladder.pilot: Exercises the harness and discovers defects. A pilot can never promote a generalization claim.
claim_ladder.bounded_generalization: The full 3-domain x 3-task x 3-repetition matrix may support only a claim scoped to the sampled domains and frozen envelope.
claim_ladder.target_population_reliability: A reliability claim additionally requires at least 29 independently selected unseen tasks from a predeclared target population, zero task-level Beast failures, and a one-sided 95% exact lower success bound of at least 0.90. This still does not mean every domain or every future version.
claim_ladder.retained_reliability: Every material model, pack, tool, or target-version change starts a new envelope and must pass canary plus periodic unseen-task replay before inheriting any reliability claim.

claim_boundary: This file defines the experiment. It is not evidence that Beast improves performance.
